# Kenney Fish Pack vector provenance

- upstream_author: Kenney
- license: CC0-1.0
- exact source file: https://github.com/MatteoMassaro/BubBlow/blob/5d7830ef6c7041787139cfa8b7cd6ae4d60a1a65/assets/sprites/kenney_fish-pack/Vector/fishPack_vector.svg

SignalDiveKenneyVectorArt.swift contains two fish variants copied as vector path fragments from the source SVG and rendered directly with SpriteKit. The path fragments retain their original geometry and palette and are public-domain CC0 material.
